data.contentEn:
‍

Investigation and sanctions for violations of the safe transaction policy

‍

‍

‍

1. A: All products will be suspended from sale for 5 days.

‍

1-1. AW Logo Duck Down Short Padding

- Violation: Incorrectly reporting the down mixing ratio

- Violation: 1 violation of the Safe Transaction Policy due to false or exaggerated advertising, 40 penalty points awarded

- Sanctions: Sales of all Musinsa products will be suspended for 5 days starting March 6, 2025.

‍

2. B: All products will be suspended from sale for 5 days.

‍

2-1. Glossy duck down jumper

- Violation: Incorrectly reporting the down mixing ratio

- Violation: 1 violation of the Safe Transaction Policy due to false or exaggerated advertising, 40 penalty points awarded

- Sanctions: Sales of all Musinsa products will be suspended for 5 days starting March 6, 2025.

‍

3. C: All products will be suspended from sale for 5 days.

‍

3-1. Hooded string goose down jumper 

- Violation: Incorrectly reporting the down mixing ratio

- Violation: 1 violation of the Safe Transaction Policy due to false or exaggerated advertising, 40 penalty points awarded

- Sanctions: Sales of all products will be suspended for 5 days starting March 6, 2025.

‍

4. D : All products will be suspended from sale for 5 days.

‍

4-1. Ribbon duck down short padding puffer

- Violation: Incorrectly reporting the down mixing ratio

- Violation: 1 violation of the Safe Transaction Policy due to false or exaggerated advertising, 40 penalty points awarded

- Sanctions: Sales of all products will be suspended for 5 days starting March 6, 2025.

‍

‍

As of March 6, 2025

‍

‍

The brand products announced today are still available on other fashion platforms and online malls even after being discontinued on Musinsa. We ask customers to exercise caution to avoid further damage.

‍

We will continue to strive to become a platform that customers can trust and rely on. Thank you.

‍

对违反安全交易政策的行为进行调查和制裁

‍

‍

‍

1. A：所有产品将暂停销售5天。

‍

1-1. AW 标志鸭绒短垫

违规事项：错误报告降水混合比

- 违规：因虚假或夸大广告宣传违反安全交易政策1次，扣除40分。

- 制裁：自 2025 年 3 月 6 日起，暂停销售所有 Musinsa 产品 5 天。

‍

2. B：所有产品将暂停销售 5 天。

‍

2-1. 亮面鸭绒套头衫

违规事项：错误报告降水混合比

- 违规：因虚假或夸大广告宣传违反安全交易政策1次，扣除40分。

- 制裁：自 2025 年 3 月 6 日起，暂停销售所有 Musinsa 产品 5 天。

‍

3. C：所有产品将暂停销售 5 天。

‍

3-1. 带帽羽绒服 

违规事项：错误报告降水混合比

- 违规：因虚假或夸大广告宣传违反安全交易政策 1 次，扣除 40 分

- 制裁措施：自 2025 年 3 月 6 日起暂停销售所有产品 5 天。

‍

4. D：所有产品将暂停销售 5 天。

‍

4-1. 缎带鸭绒短款羽绒服

违规事项：错误报告降水混合比

- 违规：因虚假或夸大广告宣传违反安全交易政策1次，扣除40分。

- 制裁措施：自 2025 年 3 月 6 日起暂停销售所有产品 5 天。

‍

‍

截至2025年3月6日

‍

‍

今天宣布的品牌产品即使在Musinsa平台下架后，在其他时尚平台和电商平台仍然可以购买。我们提醒顾客谨慎行事，以免造成进一步损失。

‍

我们将继续努力，成为客户信赖和依赖的平台。谢谢。
